title: Conan requirement declared without a version
description: conanfile.txt declares a `requires` entry that names no version. Conan resolves the reference to whatever the remote holds, so the compiled library version is decided by the remote.
remediation: Record the version in the reference and commit `conan.lock`.
limitation: It matches a `requires` entry that names no version in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
